type: Computational feasibility and structural-identifiability test; all observations synthetic
scope: Small-amplitude response of an existing spherical bubble. No laboratory measurements, cavitation nucleation, particle creation, or Stoney-scale evolution are simulated.

hypotheses.H_detect: A one-pole passive relaxation response can be detected against a fitted constant-stiffness/constant-damping baseline at the specified noise and parameters.
hypotheses.H_unique: The selected exponential-memory response is distinguishable from ordinary Maxwell viscoelasticity using radius/pressure frequency response alone.
hypotheses.H_physical: EFMW, TUFT, or a universal Stoney-scale pulsation describes physical reality; unresolved without empirical evidence and an independently derived distinctive prediction.

parameters.interpretation: Illustrative, analyst-selected effective-medium parameters, not measured properties of an identified material or EFMW predictions.

equations.thermal_counterexample: kappa_star=kappa+delta_k/(3*pg0)*i*omega*tau/(1+i*omega*tau). This is an illustrative lumped thermal-relaxation surrogate, not the complete gas heat-diffusion solution.

design.frequency_grid: 61 geometrically spaced frequencies from 2000 to 200000 Hz
design.held_out: Odd zero-based frequency indices; 30 frequencies; interpolation only
design.noise: Independent Gaussian noise in each complex quadrature of H, with standard deviation 5e-8 Pa^-1; fixed known noise for this synthetic experiment
design.baseline_fit: Fit stiffness and damping on training frequencies; inertia fixed at the synthetic calibrated value
design.memory_fit: Fit stiffness, damping, memory strength and relaxation time on training frequencies; no held-out tuning
design.optimizer: scipy least_squares with analytic Jacobian, bounded; memory starts at tau=1e-6,1e-5,1e-4 seconds; exact nested-null fallback retained

decision_rules.calibration_cutoff: 95th percentile (higher order statistic) of training delta chi-square from 500 null calibration replicates; boundary/nonidentified tau handled by simulation rather than a naive chi-square law
decision_rules.relaxation_detected: Training delta chi-square exceeds calibration cutoff AND held-out weighted RMSE falls by at least 20% AND memory-model held-out weighted RMSE is at most 1.5
decision_rules.algorithm_check_pass: Independent-null detection fraction <=0.05 and injected-memory detection fraction >=0.90; this verifies only synthetic detection performance
decision_rules.uniqueness_failure: A conventional constitutive model yields the same transfer function algebraically; numeric relative discrepancy below 1e-12 is a cross-check, not the proof
decision_rules.ode_check: Complex transfer from time integration agrees with analytic transfer to relative error <1e-5 at 5 kHz,20 kHz,nominal resonance,150 kHz for both null and memory
decision_rules.linearization_check: The first harmonic from nonlinear Newtonian RP at drive amplitude 20 Pa agrees with linear H0 to relative error <0.01 at the same frequencies
decision_rules.small_amplitude: Analytic maximum fractional radius amplitude <0.01 on a dense 2-200 kHz grid
decision_rules.falsification: Failure of the detection rules is retained and reported. No adjustment to signal, noise, split, or thresholds after seeing results.

limitations: Synthetic data cannot establish existence of the selected memory term.
The memory kernel is analyst-specified, not derived from EFMW or TUFT.
Synthetic known inertia and noise are not independent laboratory calibrations.
The baseline has constant effective damping and polytropic stiffness. It does not implement full frequency-dependent gas thermodynamics, radiation, compressible dynamics, or non-spherical modes.
A Maxwell constitutive response is an exact conventional explanation for the chosen memory model.
A one-pole thermal surrogate is another exact algebraic explanation, but is not claimed to be exact heat-diffusion physics.
This is a single illustrative parameter/noise setting and held-out interpolation, not a broad sensitivity or instrument feasibility survey.
No switch between high- and low-pressure regimes is specified in the proposal; this computation cannot test that switch.
No named Zoo animals are invented; the explicit operation checks implement the skill's consistency, anti-circularity and falsification requirements.
